culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hideka Aburai. First, she set a butterfly toy under Tokuzono's phone outside the window. When Tokuzono tried to get his phone, the toy would suddenly fly up towards him. Because Tokuzono hates bugs, he was startled by this and ended up slipping and falling to death. Odori later found the toy inside the room of the murder scene.

motive.quote: Because Tokuzono hates bugs, he was startled by this and ended up slipping and falling to death.

method.quote: She then poisoned Odori by removing a straw tip, coating it with poison, and put it on another straw like a cap.

evidence.quote: Odori later found the toy inside the room of the murder scene.

motive.zhHans: 因为 Tokuzono 讨厌虫子，他被吓了一跳，结果脚滑坠楼身亡。正因如此，他在第二天开车前往拍摄现场的途中死去了。Odori 发现她就是杀死 Tokuzono 的凶手，因为在 Tokuzono 坠楼身亡前后拍摄的画面中，尽管一个男人刚刚在她面前坠落，她却是唯一一个一直抬头望向窗户的人，于是他开始勒索她。当 Aburai 试图开车撞向大楼自杀时，她在场地上绕行了一圈，以提高车速。Tomioka 还提到兰的性格与 Yukiko 相似，以此来鼓励 Jinmei。
motive.en: Because Tokuzono hates bugs, he was startled by this and ended up slipping and falling to death. Because of that, he died while driving to the film location the next day. Odori discovered that she was the murderer who killed Tokuzono because in the footage that was taken before and after Tokuzono fell to his death, she was the only one who kept looking up to the window despite the fact that a man had just fallen in front of her, so he started to blackmail her. When Aburai tries to commit suicide by crashing into the building, she drives around the ground area one time in order to increase the car's speed. Tomioka also brings up that Ran's personality being similar to Yukiko in order to cheer Jinmei up.

method.zhHans: 随后她毒杀了 Odori：剪掉一根吸管的尖端，涂上毒药，再像帽子一样套在另一根吸管上。在推理的最后，是柯南揭露了第二起命案所用的手法其实是防止 Tokuzono 在第一次谋杀未遂中生还的保险措施，因为与直型吸管配套的奶昔一起使用这种帽盖手法风险很高，而漫画中则是 Aburai 自己说出这一点，并且没有提到吸管类型的话题。
method.en: She then poisoned Odori by removing a straw tip, coating it with poison, and put it on another straw like a cap. At the end of the deduction, it's Conan who reveals that the trick used in the second murder was infact a fail-safe in case Tokuzono survived the first murder attempt, due to the fact that it's very risky to use the cap trick with shake that normally came with straight-type straw, compared to the Manga where Aburai reveals it herself and the topic regarding straw type is not mentioned.

evidence.zhHans: Odori 事后在案发房间内发现了那个玩具。Odori 发现她就是杀死 Tokuzono 的凶手，因为在 Tokuzono 坠楼身亡前后拍摄的画面中，尽管一个男人刚刚在她面前坠落，她却是唯一一个一直抬头望向窗户的人，于是他开始勒索她。被发现之后，她试图把工作人员的面包车开进大楼自杀，但被真和兰联手救下。
evidence.en: Odori later found the toy inside the room of the murder scene. Odori discovered that she was the murderer who killed Tokuzono because in the footage that was taken before and after Tokuzono fell to his death, she was the only one who kept looking up to the window despite the fact that a man had just fallen in front of her, so he started to blackmail her. After she was discovered, she tried to commit suicide by driving the staff van into the building, but is saved by the combined efforts of Makoto and Ran.

resolution.en: The culprit is Hideka Aburai. First, she set a butterfly toy under Tokuzono's phone outside the window. When Tokuzono tried to get his phone, the toy would suddenly fly up towards him. Because Tokuzono hates bugs, he was startled by this and ended up slipping and falling to death. Odori later found the toy inside the room of the murder scene. She then poisoned Odori by removing a straw tip, coating it with poison, and put it on another straw like a cap.
